critique: The timing reads as an outward burst, but visually it is a bright radial firework: hundreds of tiny, sharply separated white bead trails form a near-perfect circular shell by 1.3s. A Smoke Explosion should resolve into a denser, softer, irregular volume of expanding smoke rather than long spoke-like particle streams. The pure white color and very small particle size also prevent any smoky mass or tonal depth.

suggestions.why: Reducing the extreme radial velocity will shorten the spoke trails and keep the burst cohesive enough to become an expanding smoke volume.
Substantially larger primary particles merge into soft smoke clumps instead of rendering as individual bead-like firework dots.
Size variation breaks the uniform radial shell and gives the plume the irregular clumped silhouette expected of an explosion.
A medium gray base creates visible smoke tonal character; the current solid white reads as sparks or an overexposed firework.
